basis: Inherited all-layer barrier and fresh factory-part routing allocation; no approved placement or manufacturing stage is claimed.

areas.basis: Retain existing primary/secondary no-new-copper allocation on all enabled layers; additional managed constraint, not a normative clearance substitute.

blocks.basis: Preserve selected circuit/return topology and current-sense separation. See spatial-basis.md; geometric audit is not EMI/fault qualification.

sensitive_nets.rationale: Preserve dedicated current-sense copper and review HV projection on every copper layer.

switching_nodes.rationale: Retain selected switching node placement and source-bound loop review.

return_paths.rationale: Retain separate capacitor/shunt/source/auxiliary branches; no shared shortcut bypass.

loops.rationale: Retain compact power loop and independent proposed graph while isolating measurement path.

kelvin_connections.rationale: Preserve dedicated positive sense connection; negative return is branch-controlled, not claimed as a complete Kelvin pair.
